lane: سِمْحَاقٌ [The _pericranium;_ i. e.] the _thin skin,_ (T, Mgh, Msb,) or _thin integument,_ (S, Mgh, K,) _above the skull:_ (T, S, Mgh, Msb, K:) and _any thin skin resembling that;_ (Msb;) or [the _periosteum_ of any bone; i. e.] the _skin that is between the bone and the flesh, above the bone and beneath the flesh;_ every bone having what is thus termed: (TA:) [pl. سَمَاحِيقُ. === Hence,] one says, عَلَى ثَرْبِ الشَّاةِ سَمَاحِيقُ مِنْ شَحْمٍ, (S, K, TA,) i. e. ‡ [_Upon the fat that covers the stomach and bowels of the sheep_ or _goat is_ or _are_] _a thin integument_ [or _thin integuments of fat_]. (TA.) === And سَمَاحِيقُ السَّمَآءِ ‡ _The_ [_strata_ or] _thin portions of cloud._ (S, K, TA.) === سِمْحَاقٌ also signifies [The _cicatrix which is_] the _mark of circumcision._ (TA.) === And _A wound by which the head is broken_ (شَجَّةٌ [q. v.]) _reaching to the thin skin,_ or _integument, thus called._ (T, S, Msb, K.)

entries.text: السمحاق، كقرطاس: قشرة رقيقة فوق عظم الرأس، وبها سميت الشجة إذا بلغتها: سمحاقا. وكعصفور من النخل: الطويلة. وسماحيق السماء: القطع الرقاق من الغيم، وعلى ثرب الشاة سماحيق من شحم.
